established.method: Fault injection, not revert: dropTargetAtPoint is a NEW export, so reverting src/lib/utils/dropTargeting.js deletes the symbol the tests import and only yields a build failure (UNPROVABLE). Instead I neutered the index computation in place to the pre-fix behaviour - multiplying the midpoint row count by 0 so the resolver always reports index 0, which is exactly what App.jsx hardcoded before this fix - then ran the two tests via refresh-tests --test, then restored the line verbatim.
established.evidence: With the fault injected: 2 failed out of 2 - 'dropTargetAtPoint > resolves the index from the row midpoints under the cursor' and 'dropTargetAtPoint > excludes the dragged row from the index count', both attributed change-introduced against base origin/main. With the line restored, refresh-tests --changed reports all 105 tests passing. The two tests are therefore load-bearing on the cursor-to-index computation, not merely compiling against it.
